environment.description: AWS Lambda (Node.js 18.x) deployed via SAM template. The KMS key (RSA_2048 asymmetric signing key) is accessible to the Lambda execution role with both kms:Sign and kms:Verify permissions. The Lambda is exposed via API Gateway HTTP API with no authorization layer. DynamoDB table 'UserRoles' allows unrestricted UpdateItem from the Lambda role. No request throttling or IP restrictions. The /api/internal/bootstrap endpoint is publicly reachable.

config.kms_key_policy: Lambda role has kms:Sign, kms:Verify, kms:DescribeKey
config.dynamodb_policy: Lambda role has dynamodb:GetItem, dynamodb:UpdateItem on UserRoles
config.network: public endpoint, no VPC, no WAF
